hazard: A completion entry records a stand-in that waits on another spec's unmerged work with no tracked follow-up, so the stand-in outlives the blocker untracked.

grader.pattern: A deviation that defers to another spec's unmerged work .* cites the tracked follow-up that fires when that work lands, an issue `#<n>` or a proposal id; file the follow-up before you write the entry
